ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: Rose Gunther “Honestly, I think this is the best trip I have ever been on! From the amazing friends I could laugh with, the enthusiastic professors that care about us, to experiencing what life is like outside of Arkansas, this trip is like none I have ever seen. I am so thankful for all the awesome people who have made this possible for kids like me and hope other students take advantage of it!”

Account name: ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: Carter Ayers “New York was unlike anything i’ve ever experienced. I really enjoyed the diverse and interesting places, food, and people. Now that I’ve made some interesting financial decisions, i’m ready to go back to seeing less people and more grass.”

Account name: ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: Morgan Blamey “NYC has been THE COOLEST experience of my collegiate career. Traveling and gaining firsthand experience is a learning curve like no other. 10/10, would recommend the Wall Street Experience to anyone.”

Account name: ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: Sarah Pham “Just getting to explore all the different parts of New York was a blast! You see so many different things you would never see in Arkansas”

Account name: ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: “Alicia Keys was lying when she said this is “Where are dreams are made of”! New York City is full of vibrant city lights and its historical backgrounds which makes the place so livid to be in. My favorite part was definitely seeing Madison Square Garden and hearing about the information there. Seeing all the luxury business buildings is inspiring to where I want my career to end up!” Josiah Carter

Account name: ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: Miguel Green “The trip was legendary, if I could restart the whole week over I would! Being from Eudora it’s rare for kids to come to college and accomplish the things I have seen and done during my 4 years here. I want to be the start from my town to show no matter where you from you can be big anywhere! ”

Account name: ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: Emma Kiser “The trip was a lot of fun and my favorite part was getting to know all these great people and creating new friendships!”

Account name: ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: Kendra Hulsey “New York City was an unforgettable trip, especially the 9/11 Memorial, Intrepid, Trump Tower, and the Harbor Lights Tour. I’d highly recommend it to anyone thinking about going next year!”

Account name: ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: Annsley Rawlins “It was amazing! A great opportunity to experience New York for the first time!

Account name: ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: Karina Herrera Gamboa “ For those who have never traveled or are scared to… don’t hesitate!! This trip opened a door for me to pursue more adventures in the future. It was even better than expected and such a well spent spring break!”

Account name: ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: Caleb Carter “New York was so much fun and I had a blast getting to go with this group! Would highly recommend going to the USS Intrepid Museum where we got to see a retired Navy Warship!”

Account name: ATU LeMoyne Smith School of Business
Description: Adeea Teter “One of the best parts about the trip is getting to know fellow classmates. I didn’t know anyone going into it, but afterwards I feel like we are all close now. We all helped each other navigate around the city and got to share experiences together. ”
